product.problem: Cross-tool model experimentation and application delivery may add effort
product.value: Portable reproducible AI application workflow in VS Code; benefit unvalidated
product.sharedOutcome: Developers and operators deliver inspectable applications with bounded effects
product.evidenceLevel: Stakeholder input and provider documentation; no observed user behavior

personas.responsibility: Experiment, build and evaluate reproducible AI applications
Authorize scope/budget and operate/clean up deployments

scenarios.trigger: Need to test a Scaleway model from a workspace
scenarios.start: Trusted workspace and authorized account; no connection saved
scenarios.end: Saved experiment and exported example run outside VS Code
scenarios.successCriterion: Complete supported streaming test and run exported example without secret leakage
scenarios.directPath: Connect, catalog, playground, save, export, run
scenarios.conversationalPath: Scoped model chat in playground; navigation stays direct
scenarios.handoff: Developer obtains approved account scope from operator
scenarios.recovery: Retain prompt edits and origin; recheck credentials; show partial results honestly

scenarios.trigger: Successful prompt needs tools and reproducibility
scenarios.end: Local bounded agent inspected and evaluated
scenarios.successCriterion: Tool policy enforced and versioned evaluation evidence saved
scenarios.directPath: Create spec, approve tools, run, inspect, evaluate
scenarios.conversationalPath: Agent test conversation inside run workspace
scenarios.handoff: Operator approves bounded tool mandate; developer owns code
scenarios.recovery: Stop new effects, preserve edits, reconcile unknown tool outcomes

scenarios.trigger: Evaluated application ready for an authorized cloud trial
scenarios.start: Exact reviewed application version and approved budget
scenarios.end: Healthy hosted run correlated with trace and tested cleanup
scenarios.successCriterion: Provisioned resources identified, runtime verified and cleanup reconciled
scenarios.directPath: Review target, activate, inspect status, test, monitor, clean up
scenarios.conversationalPath: Hosted test conversation; deployment remains explicit control
scenarios.handoff: Developer supplies evaluated version; operator authorizes scope
scenarios.recovery: Query provider state before retry and preserve created resource identities
